data.name: Thor's Workout
data.description: Godlike physique. his routine is designed primarily for muscle hypertrophy and strength, while Day 6 adds conditioning and athletic fitness. It is a demanding program because of its high training volume and six consecutive training days.

data.name: Reacher's Workout
data.description: This PowerLog routine export contains a 4-day Reacher-inspired workout program focused on functional strength, bodyweight training, explosiveness, endurance, and core stability. It includes upper body training on Monday, legs and core on Tuesday, explosive conditioning on Thursday, and running/athletic conditioning on Saturday. The routine combines exercises such as push-ups, pull-ups, squats, burpees, box jumps, bear crawls, and a 5K run for a balanced approach to strength and fitness.
